global_exclusions: No board-topology, tile-count, reward, fishing-progress or mission-state redesign.
No modal substitute for the in-world fishing catch.
No extra central Journey Disc icon on this normal Journey Disc level.
No current-baseline shapes used as identity prompts.
No ornamental detail before its parent macro group passes the 0.85 naked gate.

ambiguities_requiring_approval.question: Should generated goals imitate the painterly source literally or translate it into premium game-ready stylized 3D?
ambiguities_requiring_approval.recommendation: Use source-faithful premium stylized 3D: preserve silhouette, composition, warmth and handcrafted irregularity, while making structure, materials and animation physically readable rather than photorealistic.

ambiguities_requiring_approval.question: The peaceful source does not show the catch species or dragon. What owns their identity?
ambiguities_requiring_approval.recommendation: Treat fish as explicitly secondary-inferred and keep the accepted four-view water-dragon sheet as secondary authority. New generated sheets may clarify anatomy, scale and motion but cannot silently replace its teal aquatic identity.

ambiguities_requiring_approval.question: How much hidden/rear architecture may be invented?
ambiguities_requiring_approval.recommendation: Infer only construction needed for coherent 360-degree viewing; repeat visible source motifs and label rear/service elevations medium-confidence until approved.

ambiguities_requiring_approval.question: Which part should prove the new Three.js construction methodology?
ambiguities_requiring_approval.recommendation: Start with the coupled Guild Hall macro/detail family in its real upper-right socket. It is the largest, most source-critical landmark and will quickly falsify weak roof, entry, material and phone-budget methods before fan-out.

recommended_production_sequence: Lighthouse, tavern, boatwright and hatchery landmark families (p14–p21)
Fish market, cottage family and harbour dressing (p08–p11)
World terrain, board surface, pond, circulation, ocean, sky and occupied lighting (p01–p07)
Hero fisher, rig, catch fish family and in-world presentation (p22–p25)
Full assembly, least-flattering views, portrait-phone PWA and local Capacitor proof
